title: Tie-aware barrier labels: tie_ambiguous flag + optional 1m resolution in ml/datasets/labeling/triple_barrier.py and src/research/triple_barrier.py (label_version bump, default outputs byte-identical)
owner: build lane dispatched by the manager
note: [2026-10-14 lane DATA-INFRA-PROGRAMME, plan docs/research/programmes/06-DATA-INFRA.md, milestone L-DATA] Programme 06 Q4. WHY: both barrier libraries resolve a bar that touches both barriers as SL-first (ml/datasets/labeling/triple_barrier.py:140-209; src/research/triple_barrier.py), so setup_candidates, exit_candidates, build_intrabar_exit_panel and every first-passage label inherit a convention. How often that convention is WRONG is RQ-20261014-da7a-01's measurement. BUILD: emit tie_ambiguous on every label row; when a 1m frame is supplied (DATA-KLINE-ARCHIVE), resolve ties on it and record tie_resolution in {sl_first_convention, 1m, still_ambiguous}; label_version suffix '-ties'; defaults unchanged byte-for-byte (test). Tier-1 (offline labelling code; no serving path reads these labels live). DONE WHEN: tests prove default byte-identity and a planted tie resolved TP-first on 1m; one dataset build carries the column.
